an8.51:1.1: 51 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
an8.51:1.2: athakho mahāpajāpati gotamī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho mahāpajāpati gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.51:1.3: sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:1.5: mā te rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāti.
an8.51:2.1: dutiyampi kho mahāpajāpati gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.51:2.2: sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:2.4: mā te rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāti.
an8.51:3.1: tatiyampi kho mahāpajāpati gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.51:3.2: sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:3.4: mā te rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāti.
an8.51:4.1: athakho mahāpajāpati gotamī na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an8.51:5.1: athakho bhagavā kapilavatthusmiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi
an8.51:5.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena vesālī tadavasari
an8.51:5.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.51:5.4: athakho mahāpajāpati gotamī kese chedāpetvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā sambahulāhi sākiyāhi saddhiṃ yena vesālī tena pakkāmi
an8.51:5.5: anupubbena yena vesālī mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā tenupasaṅkami
an8.51:5.6: athakho mahāpajāpati gotamī sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi.
an8.51:6.1: addasā kho āyasmā ānando mahāpajāpatiṃ gotamiṃ sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhiṃ dummanaṃ assumukhiṃ rudamānaṃ bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitaṃ
an8.51:6.3: kiṃ nu tvaṃ gotami sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitāti.
an8.51:6.4: tathā hi pana bhante ānanda na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:6.5: tenahi gotami idheva tāva hohi yāvāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ yācāmi mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:7.1: athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.51:7.2: esā bhante mahāpajāpati gotamī sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā
an8.51:7.3: na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti
an8.51:7.4: sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:7.6: mā te rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāti.

an8.51:8.5: mā te rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāti.

an8.51:9.3: yannūnāhaṃ aññenapi pariyāyena bhagavantaṃ yāceyyaṃ mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti
an8.51:9.5: bhabbo nu kho bhante mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaphalaṃ vā sacchikātunti.
an8.51:9.6: bhabbo ānanda mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalampi sakadāgāmiphalampi anāgāmiphalampi arahattaphalampi sacchikātunti.
an8.51:9.7: sace bhante bhabbo mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalampi …pe… arahattaphalampi sacchikātuṃ
an8.51:9.8: bahukārā bhante mahāpajāpati gotamī bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā positā
an8.51:9.10: sādhu bhante labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:10.1: sace ānanda mahāpajāpati gotamī aṭṭha garudhamme paṭiggaṇhāti sāvassā hotu upasampadā.
an8.51:11.1: vassasatūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadahupasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kattabbaṃ
an8.51:11.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:12.1: na bhikkhuniyā abhikkhuke āvāse vassaṃ upagantabbaṃ
an8.51:12.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:13.3: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:14.1: vassaṃ vutthāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṅghe tīhi ṭhānehi pavāretabbaṃ
an8.51:14.3: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:15.1: garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṅghe pakkhamānattaṃ caritabbaṃ
an8.51:15.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:16.1: dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya ubhatosaṅghe upasampadā pariyesitabbā
an8.51:16.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:17.1: na kenaci pariyāyena bhikkhuniyā bhikkhu akkositabbo paribhāsitabbo
an8.51:17.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:18.1: ajjatagge ovaṭo bhikkhunīnaṃ bhikkhūsu vacanapatho anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho
an8.51:18.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:19.1: sace ānanda mahāpajāpati gotamī ime aṭṭha garudhamme paṭiggaṇhāti sāvassā hotu upasampadāti.
an8.51:20.1: athakho āyasmā ānando bhagavato santike ime aṭṭha garudhamme uggahetvā yena mahāpajāpati gotamī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā mahāpajāpatiṃ gotamiṃ etadavoca
an8.51:21.1: sace kho tvaṃ gotami aṭṭha garudhamme paṭiggaṇheyyāsi sāva te bhavissati upasampadā

an8.51:22.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo …pe…

an8.51:24.1: seyyathāpi bhante ānanda itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsanhāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā adhimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttamaṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhāpeyya
an8.51:24.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante ime aṭṭha garudhamme paṭiggaṇhāmi yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyeti.
an8.51:25.1: athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.51:25.2: paṭiggahitā bhante mahāpajāpatiyā gotamiyā aṭṭha garudhammā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyāti.
an8.51:26.1: sace ānanda nālabhissa mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ānanda brahmacariyaṃ abhavissa vassasahassameva saddhammo tiṭṭheyya
an8.51:26.2: yato ca kho ānanda mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito nadāni ānanda brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ bhavissati
an8.51:27.1: seyyathāpi ānanda yāni kānici kulāni bahuitthikāni appapurisakāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi
an8.51:27.2: evameva kho ānanda yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ cariṭṭhitikaṃ hoti
an8.51:28.1: seyyathāpi ānanda sampanne sālikkhette setaṭṭhikā nāma rogajāti nipatati evaṃ taṃ sālikkhettaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti
an8.51:28.2: evameva kho ānanda yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti
an8.51:29.1: seyyathāpi ānanda sampanne ucchukkhette mañjeṭṭhikā nāma rogajāti nipatati evaṃ taṃ ucchukkhettaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti
an8.51:29.2: evameva kho ānanda yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti
an8.51:30.1: seyyathāpi ānanda puriso mahato taḷākassa paṭikacceva pāḷiṃ bandheyya yāvadeva udakassa anatikkamanāya
an8.51:30.2: evameva kho ānanda mayā paṭikacceva bhikkhunīnaṃ aṭṭha garudhammā paññattā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyāti.
